'''AdmiralThrawn36 Cloud City Domination- Control of Bespin and Cloud City''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[AdmiralThrawn36]]
* '''Published:''' 29 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Downtown Plaza|SE-D-cloudcitydowntownplaza.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Downtown Plaza
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Cloud City Downtown Plaza Admiral.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck uses ships to make you more powerful on the ground and making it harder for the opponent to deploy. Please Rate!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Basically I control the space around Cloud City- making me much powerful. I can force drain on the ground or in space. I can also cancel reacts with senses. I added Scans so that I can hamper deployment. Defensive Fires’ are just annoying and keep opponent’s hand size down. My characters and starships give me decent brute power and I added several interrupts to add destinies. Labria (V) is a good undercover spy while allowing me to lay low on the ground if needed. The new version of Undercover also helps in battle by lowering weapon destinies. Battle Order/ First Strike works well in this deck because it is very balanced.
Many of you are probably wondering why I added Dark Manuevers. Why you ask? First off its easy to recycle and its destiny 6! Also it has its uses against weapon heavy decks and it does add one to power and two to hyperspeed.
